newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Blanch Q3 boosted by EWBCo, Paragon.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Blanch Q3 boosted by EWBCo, Paragon.

text.p: E.W. Blanch Holdings Inc, reporting improved third-quarter results, said its EWBCo and Paragon Reinsurance Risk Management Services Inc units produced new business.
Chairman Ted Blanch, in a statement, said "Both EWBCo and Paragon will continue to have a long-term significant impact on earnings."
Blanch also said the California Earthquake Authority was enacted into law during September, which should start producing revenues for the company in the fourth quarter.

"In addition, we are pleased with our wholesale operations, which broke even in the quarter," Blanch said. "We believe we have turned our wholesale operations around and are in the process of completing a strategic review of the future opportunities for this operation, including a reevaluation of the associated goodwill."
Earlier, E.W. Blanch reported third-quarter earnings rose to $0.52 per share from $0.49 a year ago. Revenues gained to $29.8 million from $27.2 million.
